title: Local affine-base restriction of one framed fraction chart
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$, $A$ affine-basis quasi-coherent graded algebra data, $L$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module, and $\psi$ a relative graded line map [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map]. For every open $W\subset T$, section $l$ of $L$ on $W$, and $n\geq0$, supply a section $P(l,n)$ of $L^{\otimes n}$ with $P(l,0)=1$ and $P(l,n+1)=l\otimes P(l,n)$. Supply coefficients $c$ satisfying $c_{U,W,l}(a)P(l,n)=\psi_U(a)|_W$ whenever $l$ is a free generator [def-sc-local-free-generator]. Let $X_i,s_i,t_i,\rho_i$ be the charts, source maps, target maps, and ring maps of [def-trf-graded-line-fraction-chart], and suppose every $\rho_i$ satisfies the stated homogeneous-fraction formula. No global invertibility or generation is assumed. Fix an index $i$, an affine $V\subset U_i$, and a point $x\in X_i$ with $h(s_i(x))\in V$. There exist an affine $W\subset W_i\cap h^{-1}V$, an open neighborhood $O\subset X_i$ of $x$, and a morphism $f:O\to X_k$, where $k$ is exactly the chart with base $V$, source open $W$, frame $l_i|_W$, degree $d_i$, and denominator $e_i|_V$. They satisfy $f;s_k=\iota_O;s_i$ and $f;t_k=\iota_O;t_i$.

proof.text: At x choose an affine W inside the original framed source open intersect h inverse V. Restrict the frame to W and the homogeneous denominator along A.res from the original base to V, keeping its positive degree. The restriction law of psi and the recursive equations for P imply equality of the new coefficient with the restriction of the old coefficient: the restricted frame power is a free generator, so cancellation is valid.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary localization functor to the structure-sheaf restriction map. It produces a spectrum morphism a from the restricted chart to the original chart. The affine section restriction square shows a;s_i=s_k. On every homogeneous fraction, hρ and the coefficient restriction equality show that the two ring maps commute with the graded restriction map. Naturality of away-chart embeddings and the relative-Proj transition equation then give a;t_i=t_k.

proof.text: The source map s_k is an open immersion and so is s_i; their factor a is an open immersion. Its range is the inverse image of W in X_i, as follows by identifying source chart ranges with coefficient basic opens and applying basicOpen_res. It contains x. Take O to be this range and f to be the inverse of the open-range isomorphism. The two factorization equations for a give the asserted source and target equations for f.

theorem gradedLineFraction_baseRefinement
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {h : T ⟶ S} {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} {L : T.Modules}
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : GradedLineFractionCoefficients h A L)
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a))
    (ρ : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading i.U) i.e.val →+*
        Localization.Away (i.coefficient c))
    (hρ : GradedLineFractionChart.FractionFormula c ρ) (i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L)
    (V : S.affineOpens) (hV : V ≤ i.U) (x : i.domain c)
    (hx : (i.source c ≫ h) x ∈ V.1) :
    ∃ (W : T.affineOpens) (hWi : W ≤ i.W) (hWV : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
      let k : GradedLineFractionChart h A L :=
        ⟨V, W, hWV, L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X := T.Opens) hWi).op i.l, i.hl.map hWi,
          i.d, i.hd, ⟨A.res hV i.e, (A.res hV).map_mem i.e.property⟩⟩
      ∃ (O : (i.domain c).Opens), x ∈ O ∧ ∃ f : O.toScheme ⟶ k.domain c,
        f ≫ k.source c = O.ι ≫ i.source c ∧
          f ≫ k.target c ρ = O.ι ≫ i.target c ρ
